title: parthenocissus vicaryana
intro: Parthenocissus vicaryana, commonly known as the Himalayan creeper, is a plant species belonging to the Vitaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, such as reducing fever, relieving cough and cold symptoms, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of P. vicaryana include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help in fighting infections and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
